description: This file defines the PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition', which is part of the HTML Purifier library. It manages the configuration, addition, and validation of HTML elements, attributes, and transformations for HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: Represents the HTML element and attribute configuration for the HTML Purifier library, allowing customization and setup of allowed elements, attributes, transformations, and content models.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds or modifies a custom attribute for a specified existing element.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element definition to the HTML profile.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Adds a blank element to override existing behavior.

methods.name: getAnonymousModule
methods.description: Retrieves an anonymous module for advanced customization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition object and its module manager.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup based on provided configuration.

methods.name: processModules
methods.description: Extracts element info and content sets from registered modules.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Configures allowed elements, attributes, parent elements, and injectors based on the input configuration.

methods.name: parseTinyMCEAllowedList
methods.description: Parses TinyMCE-style allowed element/attribute lists into structured arrays.
